notes.title: Update For Version 1.21.9
notes.notes:
1. The tank change mechanism is reset. Now you can change tanks when reborn, and ESC deselection function is added
2. Highlight when Life is going to 0. Players can customize the highlight color according to the instructions in the game
3. When changing tanks, the shield effect of tanks will no longer be retained
4. The first aid device generates a shield when being beaten. Instead, energy consumption is halved and a small amount of energy is restored in each burst
5. Weaken the recovery effect of the energy continuous recovery prop, so that it can balance with other recovery props

bugfix：
1. Fixed the bug that the shortcut key to end the game was invalid
2. Fixed the bug that energy recovery props and energy consumption props could not coexist

notes.title: update for version 1.21.8
notes.notes:
1. Slightly reduce the explosion range of enemy explosive vehicles

2. Add sound effects to enhance the game experience
	a. Add the sound effects of fire, water, electricity, mines and rockets, and no longer use the same sound effects of bullets before.
	b. Add the sound effect when bullets collide with the map boundary, and no longer use the same sound effect of hitting the tank

3. When replacing the gun barrel, the gun barrel level retains the original gun barrel level and no longer starts from 0 to better adapt to the rhythm of the leisure.
Players can purchase factory props to upgrade the gun barrel when replacing the gun barrel.
In addition, the props of the additional barrel upgrade series (the additional upgrade is obtained from 0 when converting the barrel) are modified to upgrade directly from the original barrel level when converting the barrel

4. The fire speed of the player's gun barrel is greatly increased, but the ability to counteract bullets is greatly reduced, making the gun barrel more characteristic

5. The movement speed of the enemy is only affected by the type of body, and the bullet power is only related to the barrel before. Instead, different combinations of body type and barrel jointly affect the movement speed and bullet power, making the enemy more different and richer experience

notes.title: Update for 7/24/2021
notes.notes:
1. It is not allowed to generate Already owned items unless all items are owned.
2. Items participate in the calculation of gold coins now. The more items you eat, the more gold coins you get.
3. Adjusted the amount of getting gold coins.
4. In double player mode, when the number of tanks is greater than 0 (for example, eating a life item), another player can be revived.
5. Slightly reduce the enemy's bullet speed.
6. Greatly reduce the movement speed of enemy rockets to give players sufficient reaction time.
7. Player tanks are born invincible for a short time.
8. Fix the bug that the enemy tank has the probability of not moving at the birth point.
